name: Mental Overload
body:
School divination (mind-affecting); Level occultist 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You touch the target and send a jolt of psychic information flooding into their mind.

You must succeed at a melee touch attack to affect the target. If successful, the target takes 1d8 damage per caster level (max 20d8) and the target is staggered for 1 minute. A successful Fortitude save negates the staggered condition and halves the damage.
